free_tier.stated: No free allowance in this offer. StackSocial one-time lifetime SKUs: 2 TB $59.95, 6 TB $139.95, 12 TB $249.95, 20 TB $349.95.

per_object_cap.notes: StackSocial listing states a 5GB per file cap; the direct pricing page lists unlimited file size on its plans.

egress.terms: "Unlimited bandwidth" stated on both the official pricing page and the StackSocial listing. No counter, no fair-use figure published.

interface_detail: WebDAV (Premium only), CLI with a local WebDAV server, desktop client, web app
tooling: rclone as a WebDAV remote against either the CLI's local WebDAV server (`scramble-cli webdav`) or the hosted endpoint. Documented by the vendor.
chaining: composition with the pool is unestablished
limits_note: StackSocial 6 TB SKU listing: Maximum File Size 5GB per file and Daily Upload Limit 21GB per day; once the daily limit is reached uploads stop until it resets. Fill time at 21 GB per day: 6 TB takes 285.7 days. The 20 TB SKU listing states 70 GB per day instead. WebDAV & Rclone support is listed on the paid direct plans and not on the Free plan.

identity_cost.detail: a Scramble account; the StackSocial SKU is a code redeemed within 30 days of purchase; payment and registration fields are unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: German provider, ISO 27001 infrastructure, E2E encrypted. Real product, but the lifetime SKUs are retail-consumer-shaped: per-file and per-day write caps, desktop client described as beta in reviews.
confidence_note: The 2026-11-03 evidence rows read https://www.stacksocial.com/sales/scramble-cloud-cloud-storage-lifetime-subscription-6tb (21GB per day upload limit, 5GB per file, 6TB SKU), the direct pricing page at https://info.scramble.cloud/en/pricing/ and the larger SKU listing (SKU prices, unlimited bandwidth, redemption deadline). Price and limits that decide the paid-only verdict cite vendor captures; payment and registration fields are unverified: behind a sign-up.

extras.price_verbatim: One-time, so amortise: 6 TB at €279.95 = €46.66/TB once; over 5 years that is €0.78/TB/mo, over 3 years €1.30/TB/mo. 20 TB SKU at $349.95 = $17.50/TB once = $0.29/TB/mo over 5 years. at 5 TB: the 6 TB SKU. at 20 TB: the 20 TB SKU.
